messages:
support-jen: customer on acct 0x9f is seeing 504s / timeouts to the hosted inference endpoint since 19:04 UTC. user reports long tail 30s+ latency then gateway 504. escalation opened with priority P1.
ashwin: ack — any correlation with deploys?
maria: no deploys in that window, metrics show a sudden backlog on request-queue for route /v1/generate.
eng-sre: looking at gateway logs — lots of upstream timeouts to inference workers around 19:03-19:10. gateway log snippet:
```
[19:04:12] gateway: upstream request timeout -> 504, host=worker-pool-1
[19:04:13] gateway: queued=120, inflight=16
```
eng-sre: kubernetes shows HPA/ScaledObject attempted scale but pods remained unready for a long time. suspect scale-up warmup.
support-jen: customer repro steps: steady traffic from a single tenant burst ~250 rps sustained for ~30s, then pervasive 504s.
nashwin: can we get `kubectl get hpa,scaledobject,deploy -n inference` outputs?
maria: pasted below:
```
$ kubectl get hpa inference-model -n inference
NAME               REFERENCE                 TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
inference-model    Deployment/inference-1    80%/90%   1         50        3
$ kubectl get scaledobject inference-scaled -n inference
Name: inference-scaled
Scale Target: Deployment/inference-1
CooldownPeriod: 300s
PollingInterval: 30s
MinReplicaCount: 1
MaxReplicaCount: 50
Triggers: kafka, queueLength
```
maria: note CooldownPeriod is 300s and PollingInterval 30s — that's pretty slow for short bursts.
eng-sre: Pod describe shows readiness probe failing repeatedly because model init step exceeds probe timeout:
```
Readiness probe failed: model_init_timeout (download taking ~18s, load ~22s)
Events:
  Warning  Unhealthy  Pod  Readiness probe failed: model init timeout
  Normal   Pulling    Pod  Pulling image...
  Normal   Started    Pod  Started container inference
```
sara: why is model download taking >20s? we usually cache public models in warm pool.
kelsey: warm pool prewarm job failed last night due to registry auth rotation — token 403 around 03:12 UTC. looks like warm pool didn't populate. logs: `registry: access denied (403) token expired)`
ryan: so root cause chain: warm pool didn't prewarm (auth/billing token rotate failure) -> min replicas=1 -> sudden burst triggers KEDA/HPA -> KEDA poll interval + cooldown too long -> pods start but readiness fails due to model init (no cached weights) -> gateway times out waiting for upstream -> 504s to customer.
support-jen: customer asked for timeline & rollback options.
eng-sre: immediate mitigations we can do now (minutes):
- increase MinReplicaCount to 3 for the route (temporarily) `kubectl patch scaledobject ...`
- lower KEDA PollingInterval to 5s and CooldownPeriod to 60s
- update readiness probe timeout to 60s for model-init sensitive containers
- create routing fallback to smaller distilled model (already warm) for bursts
ashwin: I'll patch scaledobject to MinReplicaCount=3 and PollingInterval=5s now.
eng-sre: patch applied, new events show scaled to 3 replicas. pushing a temporary route config to prefer warmed model variant.
support-jen: told customer we applied temporary changes and will monitor; customer asked for a postmortem.
maria: longer term actions (postmortem / backlog):
- investigate registry token rotation so warm pool prewarm has stable auth (assign to infra-auth)
- add a warm-pool healthcheck alert if prewarm failure rate >1 in 24h
- reduce default KEDA PollingInterval for bursty routes or use the new fast-scaling policy we discussed in Q4 roadmap
- add model-init synthetic test in prewarm pipeline (download+load timing)
eng-sre: repro steps to validate fix locally / staging:
1) disable warm pool cache (simulate prewarm miss)
2) send a 200 rps burst for 60s against staging route
3) watch scaledobject polling, pod events, readiness time
commands: `kubectl apply -f test-burst.yaml` and `hey -c 50 -q 0.1 -z 60s http://staging/inference/v1/generate`
ashwin: monitoring: added a temporary dashboard for queued requests + unready pods + registry 403s. alert configured `alert:ScaleupLatencyHigh` -> fires when queued > 80 and unready_pods > 1 for 2m.
ops-bot: incident channel updated, PagerDuty incident opened (PD-INC-4821).
ryan: will draft postmortem, assign action items: infra-auth (kelsey) token rotation fix, eng-runtime (maria) warm pool health, platform (ashwin) scale config defaults. ETA for initial postmortem draft 24h.
kelsey: started investigation into auth rotation; found a race where new tokens are written but the prewarm job pod uses cached credentials in secret that wasn't reloaded. putting a CronJob to refresh secret mount and restart prewarm every 6h as stopgap.
sara: also recommend changing readiness probe to allow longer init for heavy models and rely on live traffic health checks for early routing decisions.
eng-sre: final note: no code regressions or deploy errors caused this — it was a systems/config race across prewarm/auth/scale config. will include recommended SLA changes for bursty tenant patterns.
support-jen: customer updated: "Thanks for quick turnaround, we'll keep an eye but appreciate the mitigation." :thumbsup:
eng-sre: leaving this thread open until postmortem link attached. next update by 1755563000 (ETA 24h).
